summary: AbCellera Biologics Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a preclinical research collaboration, option and license agreement with Jazz Pharmaceuticals to discover and develop next-generation T-cell engaging multispecific antibodies for gastrointestinal cancers and other solid tumors. The deal includes $56 million in upfront payments to AbCellera and up to $792 million in potential option fees and milestone payments. Jazz has the exclusive option to develop and commercialize resulting therapeutic antibodies. The filing is a routine current report disclosing a research collaboration; it does not involve a change of control, shareholder vote, or special-situation transaction.
